caption: The drawing depicts a woman in profile, facing left, with fair skin and dark, wavy hair that is pulled back and partially covered by a head covering. She wears a pinkish-red garment covering her upper body and shoulders, with a yellow belt around her waist. Her skirt is predominantly dark blue with lighter blue and white highlights, and it features a yellow and red trim along the bottom edge. She has bracelets on both wrists, which appear to be green or gold, and she holds one hand to her chest. The background of the image is a plain, off-white color, and there are no other objects or figures present in the composition.
title: Figurehead: "Marie-Antoinette"
